series.name: Haier PK split inverter — official master table
series.notes: Official Haier PK self-service master table (31 codes) + per-code FAQ enrichment + service-manual §7.3 outdoor LED1 blink counts. Primary source of record.

meaning.en: The indoor room-temperature thermistor reads open/short or otherwise out of range.
meaning.ur: kamre ke temperature sensor open/short hai ya ghair mamooli reading de raha hai

causes.en: Room-temperature sensor open or short circuit
causes.ur: kamre ka sensor open ya short circuit

causes.en: Loose or damaged wiring between sensor and indoor PCB
causes.ur: Sensor aur indoor PCB ke darmiyan wiring dheli ya kharab

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance and replace the sensor if out of specification
solutions.ur: sensor ki resistance naap kar, ghair mamooli ho to sensor badlein

solutions.en: Inspect and repair the harness/connectors to the indoor control board
solutions.ur: Indoor control board tak wiring/connectors check karke marammat karein

notes.en: Service manual §7.3 confirms indoor display E1 without outdoor LED blink code; Arlington and AYS agree on sensor meaning.
notes.ur: Service manual §7.3 confirm karta hai ke indoor display E1 aata hai aur outdoor LED blink code nahi hota; Arlington aur AYS ke matlab par agree karte hain.

meaning.en: The indoor coil/pipe thermistor is open, shorted, or reporting an impossible temperature.
meaning.ur: indoor coil/pipe ka thermistor open ya short hai, ya namumkin temperature dikha raha hai

causes.en: Heat-exchanger sensor open or short circuit
causes.ur: heat exchanger sensor open ya short

causes.en: Faulty connector or PCB input on the indoor board
causes.ur: Indoor board par kharab connector ya PCB input

solutions.en: Check thermistor resistance against the normal temperature/resistance chart and replace if bad
solutions.ur: thermistor ki resistance normal chart se mila kar, kharab ho to badlein

solutions.en: Reseat/repair the sensor connector; replace indoor PCB if input stays abnormal
solutions.ur: Sensor connector durust karein; input phir bhi abnormal ho to indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Service manual §7.3.1 groups E1/E2 as thermistor abnormality (input >4.92V or <0.08V during compressor run).
notes.ur: Service manual §7.3.1 mein E1/E2 ko thermistor abnormality ke group mein rakha hai (compressor chalte waqt input >4.92V ya <0.08V).

meaning.en: The indoor unit cannot read its configuration memory chip.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit apna configuration memory chip (EEPROM) nahin parh sakta

causes.en: Indoor EEPROM chip erased or unreadable after power fluctuation
causes.ur: bijli ke voltage fluctuation se indoor EEPROM chip khaali ya harab ho jata hai

causes.en: Damaged EEPROM or indoor control PCB
causes.ur: Kharab EEPROM ya indoor control PCB

solutions.en: Power off 1–2 minutes and restart to attempt a clean re-read
solutions.ur: 1–2 minute band kr ke dobaara on karein

solutions.en: Call Haier service to re-flash/replace the chip or indoor PCB (not user-serviceable)
solutions.ur: Haier service se chip dobara program/tabdeeli karwayein (sirf ke liye nahi)

notes.en: Arlington adds reset-then-service path; AYS/Bijli say replace control board. Quarantined blogs wrongly redefine E4 as high temperature.
notes.ur: Arlington reset ke baad service wala raasta deta hai; AYS/Bijli kehte hain control board badlo. Quarantine kiye gaye blogs E4 ko ghalat taur par high temperature batate hain.

meaning.en: Evaporator is running too cold; protection latches (normal brief trip in heating, abnormal in cooling).
meaning.ur: Evaporator bohat thanda chal raha hai; protection latch ho gayi hai (heating mein maqsoor aam hai, cooling mein ghair mamooli).

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge causing coil to freeze in cooling mode
causes.ur: Cooling mode mein kam refrigerant se coil jam jaata hai

causes.en: Restricted airflow (dirty filters/blower) over-cooling the evaporator
causes.ur: gandagi filter/blower se hawa kam hona aur evaporator ka zyada thanda hona

solutions.en: In cooling mode check refrigerant level and repair any leak, then recharge
solutions.ur: Cooling mode mein gas ki level check karein, leak theek karke dobara bharwayen

solutions.en: Clean filters and ensure full airflow before retesting
solutions.ur: filters saaf karke poori airflow ki tasdeeq karein, phir dobara test karein

notes.en: AYS notes anti-frost can be normal in heating mode; severity lowered to check_restart per that note. hvacinexpert "E5=overcurrent" quarantined.
notes.ur: AYS ke note ke mutabiq heating mode mein anti-frost normal bhi ho sakta hai; usi note ki wajah se severity ko check_restart par utari gayi hai. hvacinexpert ki "E5=overcurrent" quarantine kar di gayi.

title.en: Communication fault between indoor and outdoor units
title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units ke darmiyan communication kharabi

meaning.en: Serial link between indoor and outdoor boards is down (no/invalid frames for ~4 minutes).
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor boards ka serial link band hai (taqreeban 4 minute tak frames nahi aaye)

causes.en: Broken, loose, or pinched inter-unit wiring / connectors
causes.ur: units ke darmiyan wiring/connector tooti, dheeli ya dabi hui

causes.en: Faulty indoor main PCB or outdoor module not responding
causes.ur: Kharab indoor main PCB ya outdoor module jawab nahi de raha

solutions.en: Power off 5–15 s and restart once after checking inter-unit harness
solutions.ur: wiring check ke baad 5–15 second band kr ke ayk bar on karein

solutions.en: Repair wiring/connectors; replace indoor PCB or outdoor module if link stays dead
solutions.ur: Wiring/connectors theek karein; link phir bhi marad ho to indoor PCB ya outdoor module badlein

source.title: Haier Pakistan master error table + E7 FAQ

notes.en: Official E7 FAQ confirms communication fault. Japan Electronics E7 blog (outdoor-fan framing) quarantined. Service manual blink 15 confirmed.
notes.ur: Official E7 FAQ communication fault confirm karti hai. Japan Electronics E7 blog (outdoor-fan wala framing) quarantine kar diya gaya. Service manual blink 15 confirm hai.

title.en: Indoor unit overload in heating mode
title.ur: Heating mode mein indoor unit par overload

meaning.en: Indoor unit hits high work-intense/overload protection while heating.
meaning.ur: Heating ke dauran indoor unit zyada load/overload protection mein aa jata hai

causes.en: Clogged filters/coils forcing the indoor blower to overwork
causes.ur: gandagi filters/coil indoor blower ko zyada mehnat par majboor kar rahe hain

causes.en: Restricted airflow or dirty evaporator raising head pressure during heat
causes.ur: hawa kam hone ya gandagi evaporator se heating main head pressure barh jana

solutions.en: Power off 3–5 minutes (longer if overheated) and restart after cleaning filters/coils
solutions.ur: 3–5 minute band rakhein, filters/coil saaf karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If it returns, call service for overload/PCB inspection
solutions.ur: wapis aaie to service se aoor load/PCB check karoaiyn

notes.en: CONFLICT: AYS+Bijli define E9 as water-flow switch/drainage; official PK table says indoor overload in heating (Arlington agrees with overload). Drainage meaning not adopted. Blink x21 from Arlington only (not in service manual §7.3 list).
notes.ur: CONFLICT: AYS+Bijli E9 ko water-flow switch/drainage kehte hain; official PK table heating mein indoor overload batati hai (Arlington bhi overload se agree karti hai). Drainage wala matlab nahi liya gaya. Blink x21 sirf Arlington se hai (service manual §7.3 list mein nahi).

meaning.en: Indoor DC fan speed feedback missing/abnormal (Hall IC no signal within 2 minutes).
meaning.ur: Indoor DC fan ki speed feedback ghair mamooli (2 minute mein Hall IC se signal nahi)

causes.en: Broken wire inside fan motor or damaged motor lead wires
causes.ur: fan motor ke andar wire tooti ya motor ki lead wiring kharab

causes.en: Stuck/bladed fan or faulty indoor PCB drive
causes.ur: Fan ruka/jam hua ya indoor PCB drive kharab

solutions.en: Power cycle, free the blades by hand, and clean debris from the blower
solutions.ur: band/on karein, blades ko hath se aazad ghumayein aur blower se gandagi saaf karein

solutions.en: Check motor supply (DC310V) and feedback; replace fan motor or indoor PCB as indicated
solutions.ur: motor ki supply (DC310V) aur feedback check karein, zaroorat par fan motor ya PCB badlein

notes.en: Service manual §7.3.2 detection logic and checks used for causes/solutions.
notes.ur: Causes/solutions ke liye service manual §7.3.2 ki detection logic aur checks use ki gayi hain.

meaning.en: Outdoor power module (IPM) thermal/abnormal protection has tripped.
meaning.ur: outdoor power module (IPM) ki garmi/ghair mamooli hifazat trip hui hai

causes.en: IPM over-temperature or unstable DC bus feeding the module
causes.ur: IPM ka temperature zyada hona ya module ko chalane wala DC bus naapaidar hona

causes.en: Loose wiring between IPM and main PCB, or faulty PCB
causes.ur: IPM aur main PCB ke darmiyan dheeli (loose) wiring ya kharab PCB

solutions.en: Unplug the machine and call the Haier service hotline (official FAQ: engineer-only)
solutions.ur: machine ka plug nikaalein aur Haier service hotline par call karein (official: sirf engineer)

solutions.en: After power rest, service checks IPM temperature, bus voltage, and module-PCB harness
solutions.ur: Power rest ke baad service IPM ki temperature, bus voltage aur module-PCB wiring check karti hai

notes.en: Official F1 FAQ: "Outdoor power module fault — only can be operated by service engineers." Japan Electronics F1=communication and hvacinexpert F1=sensor are quarantined.
notes.ur: Official F1 FAQ: "Outdoor power module fault — ise sirf service engineers chala sakte hain." Japan Electronics F1=communication aur hvacinexpert F1=sensor dono quarantine kiye gaye hain.

title.en: Instantaneous over-current protection of the compressor
title.ur: compressor ki foran over current hifazat

meaning.en: Compressor drew a momentary current spike and protection cut in.
meaning.ur: compressor ka current achanak barha aur hifazat ne kat diya

causes.en: Unstable supply voltage or weak power source
causes.ur: Unstable supply voltage ya kamzor power source

causes.en: Compressor or winding fault pulling high amps at start
causes.ur: compressor ya winding kharab hone se shuru main zyada amps

solutions.en: Restart after 1–3 minutes off; verify line voltage is stable
solutions.ur: 1–3 minute band rakh kar dobara on karein; line voltage paidaar check karein

solutions.en: Have service inspect power path, PCB, and compressor if the fault repeats
solutions.ur: bar bar aaie to service power path, PCB aur compressor check karwayein

notes.en: Service manual outdoor blink 24 = compressor overcurrent. hvacinexpert F2=sensor quarantined.
notes.ur: Service manual ke mutabiq outdoor blink 24 = compressor overcurrent. hvacinexpert F2=sensor wala dawa quarantine kiya gaya.

title.en: Communication error between power module and main PCB
title.ur: power module aur main PCB ke darmiyan communication ki ghalati

meaning.en: Outdoor IPM/power stage is not exchanging valid data with the outdoor main board.
meaning.ur: outdoor IPM/power stage main board se durust data tbadal nahi kar raha

causes.en: Open/short or loose harness between module and outdoor PCB
causes.ur: module aur outdoor PCB ke darmiyan wiring open/short ya dheeli (loose) ho

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB or module interface
causes.ur: kharab outdoor PCB ya module interface

solutions.en: Power off, inspect and reseat the module-PCB connector
solutions.ur: band karke module-PCB connector check kar ke durust lagayein

solutions.en: Replace faulty harness/components under service
solutions.ur: service ke under kharab wiring/parts tabdeeli karwayein

notes.en: Service manual blink 4 = IPM/outdoor PCB communication. hvacinexpert F3=refrigerant shortage quarantined.
notes.ur: Service manual blink 4 = IPM/outdoor PCB communication. hvacinexpert F3=refrigerant shortage wala dawa quarantine kar diya gaya.

meaning.en: Compressor discharge ran hotter than allowed; high-temperature protection latched.
meaning.ur: compressor discharge ijazat se zyada garm tha; high temperature protection latch ho gayi

causes.en: Faulty electronic expansion valve (official FAQ)
causes.ur: kharab electronic expansion valve (official FAQ)

causes.en: Faulty discharge/thermistor sensor or PCB (official FAQ)
causes.ur: kharab discharge thermistor ya PCB (official FAQ)

causes.en: Low refrigerant or dirty condenser raising discharge temp (Arlington/AYS)
causes.ur: Low refrigerant ya ganda condenser se discharge temperature barh jana (Arlington/AYS)

solutions.en: Unplug and call Haier service — official FAQ says engineer-only
solutions.ur: plug nikaalein aur Haier service ko bulayein — official FAQ: sirf engineer

solutions.en: Service checks EEV, thermistor, PCB, refrigerant charge and condenser
solutions.ur: Service EEV, thermistor, PCB, refrigerant charge aur condenser check karti hai

notes.en: FAQ lists causes EEV / thermistor / PCB; blink x8 from service manual §7.3 (= exhaust overheat).
notes.ur: FAQ mein causes EEV / thermistor / PCB likhi hain; blink x8 service manual §7.3 se hai (= exhaust overheat).

title.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor kharab hona

meaning.en: Outdoor ambient thermistor is open, shorted, or out of range.
meaning.ur: outdoor ambient thermistor open, short ya had se bahar hai

causes.en: Ambient sensor open or short circuit
causes.ur: ambient sensor open ya short

causes.en: Damaged sensor wiring to outdoor PCB
causes.ur: outdoor PCB tak sensor wiring kharab

solutions.en: Verify sensor resistance and replace the sensor if abnormal
solutions.ur: sensor ki resistance check karein, ghair mamooli ho to badlein

solutions.en: Repair harness/connectors if the sensor reads correctly on the bench
solutions.ur: sensor theek nikle to wiring/connectors ki marammat karein

source.title: Haier Pakistan master error table + F6 FAQ

notes.en: F66 is an Arlington-listed display alias of F6. Service manual blink 12 = ambient sensor.
notes.ur: F66 Arlington ki list mein F6 ka display alias hai. Service manual blink 12 = ambient sensor.

meaning.en: Suction-line thermistor open/short/out of range.
meaning.ur: suction line ka thermistor open/short/had se bahar

causes.en: Suction temperature sensor open or short circuit
causes.ur: suction sensor open ya short

causes.en: Poor connector contact on outdoor PCB
causes.ur: outdoor PCB par connector ka kamzor rabta

solutions.en: Measure and replace the suction sensor if out of spec
solutions.ur: naap kar, ghair mamooli ho to suction sensor badlein

solutions.en: Clean/repair connector and wiring
solutions.ur: connector aur wiring saaf/theek karein

source.title: Haier Pakistan master error table + F7 FAQ

notes.en: Service manual blink 11 = SUCK temperature sensor.
notes.ur: Service manual ke mutabiq blink 11 = SUCK temperature sensor.

meaning.en: Outdoor DC fan motor not running or feedback abnormal.
meaning.ur: outdoor DC fan motor nahin chal rahi ya feedback ghair mamooli hai

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor failure or seized blades
causes.ur: outdoor fan motor kharab ya blades jamy huin

causes.en: Dirt/debris in the outdoor fan or bad wiring
causes.ur: outdoor fan mein gandagi ya kharab wiring

solutions.en: Clean the outdoor fan, rotate by hand until free, and restart
solutions.ur: outdoor fan saaf karein, hath se ghumakar aazad karein aur dobara on karein

solutions.en: Service checks motor windings/supply and replaces the DC fan motor if dead
solutions.ur: service motor winding/supply check karke, kharab ho to DC fan motor badlein

source.title: Haier Pakistan master error table + F8 FAQ

notes.en: Service manual blink 9 = outdoor fan motor.
notes.ur: Service manual ke mutabiq blink 9 = outdoor fan motor.

title.ur: Power module ka reset ho jana

meaning.en: Power module requested a reset / came out of a fault latch.
meaning.ur: power module ne restart kiya / kharabi se bahar nikal aaya

causes.en: Transient module fault after voltage disturbance
causes.ur: Voltage event ke baad transient module fault

causes.en: Module hardware needing replacement if reset does not hold
causes.ur: restart ke baad bhi theek na ho to module ki hardware tabdeeli darkaar

solutions.en: Restart the AC once; if F9 returns, service replaces the faulty module
solutions.ur: AC ko ek baar restart karein; F9 wapas aaye to service kharab module badle

solutions.en: Verify supply stability before condemning the module
solutions.ur: module badalne se pehle supply ka paidaar hona check karein

source.title: Haier Pakistan master error table + F9 FAQ

notes.en: No dedicated blink count in service manual §7.3 outdoor list.
notes.ur: Service manual §7.3 outdoor list mein koi alag blink count nahi diya gaya.

title.ur: toazn khone ki detection (loss of synchronism)

meaning.en: Compressor drive lost phase synchronism with the inverter control.
meaning.ur: compressor drive ne inverter control ke sath phase synchronism kho diya

causes.en: Drive deviating from normal compressor operation (service manual)
causes.ur: drive compressor ki normal amliyat se hat gaya (service manual)

causes.en: Tripped breaker or blown fuse after voltage event
causes.ur: Voltage event ke baad breaker trip ya blown fuse

solutions.en: Power cycle after 1–3 minutes; check breakers and replace blown fuses
solutions.ur: 1–3 minute baad restart karein, breaker aur fuse check karein

solutions.en: If persistent, service inspects compressor drive circuit
solutions.ur: jary rahe to service compressor drive circuit check kare

notes.en: Service manual blink 18 = compressor deviate from normal.
notes.ur: Service manual blink 18 = compressor normal se deviate karta hai.

meaning.en: Outdoor unit cannot read its EEPROM configuration.
meaning.ur: outdoor unit apna EEPROM configuration nahin parh sakta

causes.en: Outdoor EEPROM empty, checksum error, or chip damaged
causes.ur: outdoor EEPROM khaali, checksum ghalat ya chip kharab

causes.en: Voltage fluctuation corrupting stored parameters
causes.ur: bijli ke voltage ke ochar se mehfooz parameters kharab hona

solutions.en: Power-cycle once; otherwise service re-flashes or replaces outdoor PCB/EEPROM
solutions.ur: ek baar restart karein; warna service PCB/EEPROM dobara program ya badle

solutions.en: Check supply quality to prevent recurrence
solutions.ur: dobaara na ho is ke liye supply ki quality check karein

notes.en: Arlington lists display alias E12 for the same fault (blink x1 = outdoor EEPROM in service manual).
notes.ur: Arlington usi fault ke liye display alias E12 list karti hai (blink x1 = service manual mein outdoor EEPROM).

meaning.en: Charge is low enough to trigger protection (leak or undercharge).
meaning.ur: gas itni kam hai ke hifazat trigger ho jati hai (leak ya kam charge)

causes.en: Refrigerant leak in the circuit
causes.ur: circuit mein refrigerant leak

causes.en: Factory undercharge or servicehistory short fill
causes.ur: factory kam charge ya sabq service mein kam gas

solutions.en: Leak-test, repair the leak, then evacuate and recharge to spec
solutions.ur: leak test karke leak theek karein, evacuate karein aur mutabiq gas bharwayein

solutions.en: Clean condenser/fans while service is on site
solutions.ur: Service ke waqt condenser/fan saaf karein

notes.en: Blink x16 from Arlington (not in service manual §7.3 excerpt list). Distinct from AYS F0 "low refrigerant (may not display)".
notes.ur: Blink x16 Arlington se hai (service manual §7.3 excerpt list mein nahi). Isay AYS F0 "low refrigerant (may not display)" se alag rakhein.

meaning.en: Four-way reversing valve (heat/cool changeover) did not respond correctly.
meaning.ur: four way reversing valve (heating/cooling tabdeeli) durust jawab nahi de raha

causes.en: Stuck or faulty 4-way valve
causes.ur: 4 oe oalo jamy ya kharab

causes.en: Wiring/coil fault on the reversing valve
causes.ur: reversing valve ki wiring/coil kharab

solutions.en: Service checks valve coil, wiring, and mechanical action; replaces valve if stuck
solutions.ur: service valve coil, wiring aur mechanical action check kare; jamy ho to valve badle

solutions.en: Verify changeover between heating and cooling modes
solutions.ur: Heating aur cooling mode ki tabdeeli ki tasdeeq karein

notes.en: No blink count published in sources reviewed.
notes.ur: Jo sources review kiye gaye un mein koi blink count shaya nahi hua.

title.ur: Power ke over/under voltage ki protection

meaning.en: Mains voltage outside the safe window; protection blocked operation.
meaning.ur: Mains voltage safe range se bahar hai; protection ne chalna rok diya

causes.en: Grid over-voltage or brown-out / under-voltage
causes.ur: Grid par over-voltage ya brown-out / under-voltage

causes.en: Undersized or faulty stabilizer/wiring
causes.ur: nakafy ya kharab stabilizer/wiring

solutions.en: Check line voltage with a meter; use a proper stabilizer if supply is unstable
solutions.ur: Meter se line voltage naapein; supply unstable ho to munsif stabilizer lagayein

solutions.en: Inspect power cord, socket, and internal harness for damage
solutions.ur: Power cord, socket aur internal wiring ki kharabi check karein

source.title: Haier Pakistan master error table + F19 FAQ

notes.en: Service manual blink 6 = power voltage too high or low.
notes.ur: Service manual blink 6 = power voltage zyada ya kam hona.

meaning.en: System high-pressure cut-out tripped.
meaning.ur: system ke aaly dba ka cut aat trp hawa

causes.en: Dirty or blocked condenser rejecting heat poorly
causes.ur: Ganda ya blocked condenser garmi theek se nahi nikal raha

causes.en: Non-condensables or overcharge raising head pressure
causes.ur: non-condensables ya zyada gas se head pressure barh jana

solutions.en: Clean condenser coils and remove obstructions around the outdoor unit
solutions.ur: Condenser coil saaf karein aur outdoor unit ke aard-gird rukaot hatayein

solutions.en: Service verifies pressure, charge, and fan operation if it trips again
solutions.ur: dobaara trp ho to service dba gas aur fn kam check kre

notes.en: Official table only; no blink count found.
notes.ur: Sirf official table se mila; koi blink count nahi mila.

title.ur: Outdoor coil temperature sensor kharab ho jana

meaning.en: Outdoor coil (defrost) thermistor open/short/out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil (defrost) thermistor open/short/range se bahar

causes.en: Defrost/coil sensor open or short circuit
causes.ur: Defrost/coil sensor open ya short circuit

causes.en: Damaged sensor wiring
causes.ur: sensor wiring kharab

solutions.en: Measure and replace the coil sensor if abnormal
solutions.ur: naap kar, ghair mamooli ho to coil sensor badlein

solutions.en: Repair harness to outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: outdoor PCB tak wiring ki marammat karein

notes.en: Service manual blink 10 = frost-removing temperature sensor (Arlington agrees x10).
notes.ur: Service manual blink 10 = frost-removing temperature sensor (Arlington bhi x10 par agree karti hai).

title.en: Outdoor alternating current over current protection

meaning.en: Outdoor unit AC-side current exceeded the protection threshold.
meaning.ur: outdoor unit ki AC side ka current hifazat ki had se zyada ho gaya

causes.en: Electrical fault or failing component drawing excess current
causes.ur: electrical kharabi ya kharab component zyada current draw kar raha hai

causes.en: Unstable mains feeding the outdoor unit
causes.ur: outdoor ko naapaidar mains supply

solutions.en: Rest 5–10 minutes, verify supply voltage, then restart
solutions.ur: 5–10 minute aaram dein, supply voltage check karke phir restart karein

solutions.en: Service checks power supply, PCB, and compressor if it recurs
solutions.ur: bar bar aaie to service power supply, PCB aur compressor check kare

notes.en: Service manual blink 3 = overcurrent protection of AC electricity for outdoor model; Arlington maps it to F22.
notes.ur: Service manual blink 3 = outdoor model ke liye AC electricity ki overcurrent protection; Arlington ise F22 par map karti hai.

meaning.en: One compressor phase (U, V, or W) pulled overcurrent.
meaning.ur: compressor kisi ek phase (U, V ya W) par zyada current le raha hai

causes.en: Compressor winding or lead fault on a phase
causes.ur: kisi phase par compressor winding ya lead kharab

causes.en: Wiring/connection damage between drive and compressor
causes.ur: drive aur compressor ke darmiyan wiring/connection kharab

solutions.en: Apply F22 checks first (supply, PCB); then have service megger/test compressor
solutions.ur: pehle F22 jaise check karein, phir service se compressor ka megger/test karwayein

solutions.en: Repair or replace compressor if a phase is shorted to ground
solutions.ur: koi phase ground tak short ho to compressor ki marammat/tabdeeli karein

notes.en: Service manual blink 25 = single-phase compressor overcurrent; official table splits U/V/W under F23.
notes.ur: Service manual blink 25 = single-phase compressor overcurrent; official table U/V/W ko F23 ke under split karti hai.

title.ur: CT (current transformer) detection current ki ghair mamooli hifazat

meaning.en: Current-transformer sensing circuit reported abnormal current.
meaning.ur: Current-transformer (CT) sensing circuit ne ghair-mamooli current dikhaya hai.

causes.en: CT or its wiring faulty
causes.ur: CT ya is ki wiring kharab

causes.en: Real overcurrent or PCB sensing error
causes.ur: asli over current ya PCB sensing kharabi

solutions.en: Service checks CT and related wiring against measured load current
solutions.ur: service CT aur wiring ko load current se moazna kare

solutions.en: Replace CT or repair PCB circuit as indicated
solutions.ur: zaroorat par CT badlein ya PCB circuit ki marammat karein

notes.en: AYS wording "abnormal current detection for CT" matches official.
notes.ur: AYS ka lafz "abnormal current detection for CT" official se match karta hai.

meaning.en: Discharge temperature thermistor open/short/out of range.
meaning.ur: discharge temperature thermistor open/short/had se bahar

causes.en: Discharge sensor open or short circuit
causes.ur: discharge sensor open ya short

causes.en: Sensor harness damaged by heat at the compressor
causes.ur: compressor ki garmi se sensor wiring kharab

solutions.en: Measure and replace the discharge sensor
solutions.ur: Discharge sensor naap kar usay badlein

solutions.en: Route and secure wiring away from hot surfaces
solutions.ur: wiring ko garam surfaces se door rakh kar mehfooz karein

notes.en: Service manual blink 13 = exhaust temperature sensor; Arlington agrees x13.
notes.ur: Service manual blink 13 = exhaust temperature sensor; Arlington bhi x13 par agree karti hai.

meaning.en: Drive cannot sample compressor current correctly (Arlington: locked-rotor class fault).
meaning.ur: Drive compressor ka current theek se sample nahi kar sakta (Arlington: locked-rotor class fault)

causes.en: Current-sense circuit/wiring fault on the outdoor board
causes.ur: outdoor board par current sensing circuit/wiring kharab

causes.en: Compressor locked rotor drawing extreme amps at start
causes.ur: Compressor ka locked rotor shuru mein bohat zyada amps leta hai

solutions.en: Service verifies sampling circuit wiring first
solutions.ur: service pehle sampling circuit ki wiring check kare

solutions.en: Professional compressor diagnosis (start amps); repair/replace compressor if locked
solutions.ur: Professional compressor diagnosis (start amps); locked ho to marammat ya tabdeeli

notes.en: Blink x7 from Arlington only (not in service manual §7.3 excerpt). Locked-rotor detail is Arlington interpretation.
notes.ur: Blink x7 sirf Arlington se hai (service manual §7.3 excerpt mein nahi). Locked-rotor wali detail Arlington ka interpretation hai.

meaning.en: Rotor position/loop-of-the-station detection failed for the compressor drive.
meaning.ur: compressor drive ki rotor position/loop detection naqam

causes.en: Damaged/loose wiring between compressor and drive components
causes.ur: compressor aur drive components ke darmiyan kharab/dheeli wiring

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB/IPM or compressor itself
causes.ur: kharab outdoor PCB/IPM ya khud compressor

solutions.en: Check and repair compressor harness/connectors
solutions.ur: compressor wiring/connectors check kar ke marammat karein

solutions.en: Service replaces PCB/IPM or compressor based on tests
solutions.ur: test ki bunyaad par service PCB/IPM ya compressor badle

notes.en: Service manual blink 19 = loop of the station detect error; Arlington agrees x19.
notes.ur: Service manual blink 19 = loop of the station detect error; Arlington bhi x19 par agree karti hai.

meaning.en: The compressor driver board is not functioning and must be replaced.
meaning.ur: compressor driver board kaam nahin kar raha, tabdeeli zaroori hai

causes.en: Driver board hardware failure
causes.ur: Driver board ka hardware kharab

causes.en: Prior electrical stress damaging the driver stage
causes.ur: sabq electrical stress se driver stage kharab hona

solutions.en: Service replaces the compressor driver board
solutions.ur: service compressor driver board badle

solutions.en: Recheck supply and load after board swap
solutions.ur: Board badalne ke baad supply aur load dobara check karein

notes.en: No blink count published in reviewed sources.
notes.ur: Jo sources review kiye gaye, un mein koi blink count shaya nahi hua.

title.ur: Model matching theek na hone ki halat

meaning.en: Indoor and outdoor units are not a matched pair (capacity/model mismatch).
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units matched pair nahi hain (capacity/model match nahi karti)

causes.en: Replacement outdoor unit does not match indoor model
causes.ur: Replacement outdoor unit indoor model se match nahi karta

causes.en: Incorrect model configuration written after service
causes.ur: service ke baad ghalat model configuration likhi gayi

solutions.en: Verify nameplate compatibility of indoor and outdoor units
solutions.ur: indoor aur outdoor units ki nameplate ke mutabiq tasdeeq karein

solutions.en: Fit the correct matched outdoor unit or reconfigure under service
solutions.ur: durust matched outdoor unit lagaiyn ya service ke under configuration durust karein

notes.en: AYS solution matches: check indoor/outdoor compatibility.
notes.ur: AYS wala solution yehi hai: indoor/outdoor compatibility check karein.

title.ur: Refrigerant leak detection ki kharabi (fixed-frequency AC)

meaning.en: Built-in leak detection flagged refrigerant loss on fixed-frequency models.
meaning.ur: fixed frequency models mein andar ka leak detection ne gas ki kami pakri

causes.en: Actual refrigerant leak in the system
causes.ur: system mein asli refrigerant leak

causes.en: Leak-detection sensor/board false trigger
causes.ur: leak detection sensor/board ka ghalat trigger

solutions.en: Service leak-tests, repairs the leak, and recharges
solutions.ur: service leak test karke marammat aur dobara gas bhar deta hai

solutions.en: Confirm sensor is not false-alarming after repair
solutions.ur: marammat ke baad sensor ka ghalat alarm na ho, tasdeeq karein

notes.en: Official table scopes FE to fixed-frequency AC refrigerant leaking detection.
notes.ur: Official table mein FE ko fixed-frequency AC refrigerant leaking detection tak limited rakha hai.
